subject: Vendor onboarding: PO number and line-item mapping for RedForest integration

From: Maya Singh <vendor_admin@greenbaylogistics.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: accounts_payable@greenbaylogistics.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO number and line-item mapping for RedForest integration

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for starting the onboarding for GreenBay's RedForest integration. We're close to completing our intake but ran into two things that need clarification before we can accept the provisioning PO:

1) PO number: our AP team only recognizes formal PO numbers for routing to vendor portals. We received a provisional token in the intake form but not a formal PO code. Can you confirm whether Redwood will issue a PO or if we should proceed with a provisional reference?

2) Line items: the SKUs we submitted in the form were split differently in the system (two lines condensed into one). Our finance team needs the original 3-line breakdown for cost center allocation and tax treatment.

I've attached the onboarding_form_greenbay_v2.pdf and the original line-item export for reference (we can re-export if that helps).

Can we get a response by end of day PDT? We have a scheduled billing sync on Monday and want to avoid hold-ups.

Thanks,

Maya Singh
Vendor Onboarding Lead
GreenBay Logistics
attachments: onboarding_form_greenbay_v2.pdf (application/pdf), greenbay_lineitems_v1.csv (text/csv)
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Maya Singh <vendor_admin@greenbaylogistics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO number and line-item mapping for RedForest integration

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear note and the attachments.

Quick answers and next steps:
- PO issuance: We can issue an official PO number from Procurement. For short-term provisioning we use a provisional reference, but we'll create a formal PO and notify AP. Please confirm whether GreenBay requires the PO to be visible on your portal or just included on invoices — either is fine, we can provide both.
- Line items: I see the condensed entry in your CSV. If you can confirm the three original SKU lines (description + qty + unit price) I'll escalate to Procurement and request a corrected PO that preserves the line breakdown.

Ben / Laura — looping you in. Ben, can you provision a formal PO for GreenBay and set a hard spend cap for the initial contract period (Q3 trial)? Laura, we may need a quick line-item PO amendment rather than reissuing everything.

Maya — attaching a link to our onboarding checklist and the intake form we used: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GxOnboarding/greenbay (see onboarding_form_greenbay_v2.pdf).

Best,

Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Team — forwarding GreenBay's note. Key ask: formal PO issuance + preserve original 3-line item breakdown. They want a spend cap for Q3 trial (they expect to use ~USD 22k over 3 months).

Notes:
- Vendor requests PO visible in portal and on invoices (preferred).
- If we do a PO amendment, ensure the accounting code maps to sales team cost center 6102 and that tax treatment runs through 941A.

Can you confirm whether a line-item amendment is quicker than reissuing? If so, can we do amendment and push PO number POC-xxxx to GreenBay today?

Aisha

> Ben / Laura — looping you in. Ben, can you provision a formal PO for GreenBay and set a hard spend cap for the initial contract period (Q3 trial)?

Aisha / Maya — I've created the formal PO: PO number POC-78421. I've set the trial spend cap to USD 25,000 to give a small buffer above their estimate; we can lower to 22k if they prefer.

Line-item handling: I applied an amendment that expands the condensed line back into the three original lines as provided in GreenBay's CSV. Attached is the PO_POC-78421.pdf (formal PO) and a redlined summary of the change. Please note the accounting tags: 6102 (sales demo), 941A (tax misc).

Action items:
- Maya: confirm you can see POC-78421 in your portal or if you need us to transmit via your vendor portal ingestion endpoint.
- Laura: please confirm we didn't miss any required procurement approvals — I used the standard onboarding template but flagged as 'trial' for faster routing.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben — we received POC-78421 and the redlined summary. The PO looks good and the three-line split matches our internal cost centers. We can see the PO in the portal when we search by that number.

We've uploaded the corrected line items (greenbay_lineitems_v1.csv) and a signed onboarding acknowledgment to your shared Drive folder. AP will process invoices against POC-78421 starting next billing cycle.

One small ask: please keep the spend cap at USD 25,000 for the trial. Our forecasting prefers a small buffer. If usage exceeds that, we'll route a change request through your portal.
